en: Added `--settings <file>` to `claude remote-control`, which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart `claude remote-control`
zh: 为 `claude remote-control` 新增 `--settings <file>`，将设置文件应用到它启动的每个 session；如果文件发生变化，在你重启 `claude remote-control` 之前不会启动新的 session
